//: DocFX generates the .NET API REFERENCE ONLY. The documentation site itself -- landing
page, getting started, the example pages and the live WebAssembly demo -- is Astro
Starlight, in docs/site/. CI merges DocFX's output into that site as a static subtree
`src: api` + `dest: .` is what makes the subtree self-contained: every generated page
and the template's own assets land at the ROOT of _apisite, and DocFX references them
relatively, so copying _apisite to _site/api/ gives working URLs at any base path --
the same portability rule the WebAssembly demo follows. Building with the default
src/dest instead would put the pages under _apisite/api/ while the template assets sat
beside them, so every page would end up at /api/api/.
